{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, especially positive sentiment which creates upward bias",
    "When sentiment turns positive, model forecasts under-forecast the true outcome by 0.5-1.0 for the next 5-10 days",
    "Negative sentiment changes cause model to over-forecast when prices are bottoming, creating 0.3-0.6 bias for initial days",
    "Sentiment zero means model mean-reversion to 66-67 range which aligns with prices but diverges from actual 68-70 volatility",
    "When price trend is up, correct model forecast upward by averaging excess with true outcome bias",
    "Detect sentiment-driven divergence by comparing forecast slope to true outcome slope over first 10 days",
    "Model lacks recognition of sentiment inflection points causing 2-3 day lags after sentiment shifts"
] }
